claims.summary: The Japan Foundation’s passive chart forms Group 1 passives by changing dictionary-form -u to -a and adding れる, with examples 行う→行われる and 開く→開かれる.

locator.description: Elementary 2, Lesson 7, tabla “How to make the passive-form ①”, PDF p. 144 (página impresa L7-21), líneas 11373–11401: grupo 1 -u a -a + れる; 行う→行われる, 開く→開かれる.
